To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
A very strong electroosmotically driven counterflow was produced in the isotachophoretic system on nitrocellu-lose membranes.

(a) the counterflow is very strong and opposite in direction, (b) it is much higher than the rates of migration of organic anions, and (c) it is equal in rate to the migration of Cl-/beta-alinine boundary, which is the highest rate of migration of organic ions in the system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
an application of the counterflow for the detection of DNA-binding proteins on nitrocelluose membranes.
the development of an automatic method for the detection of antibodies to ds- and to ss-DNA, and to DNA modified by different adducts.
a new technique of detection and identification of DNA-binding proteins.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the counterflow technique is an extremely simple and efficient method to determine DNA-binding proteins, which can be applied to the analysis of DNA-protein interaction in vitro, as well as in the analysis of DNA in cell nuclei.
the described method is a very useful, sensitive and rapid technique for the detection of DNA-binding proteins.
countercurrent isotacho- phoresis on nitrocelluose membranes can be used for the detection of DNA-binding proteins.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

a very strong counterflow was found on nitrocelluose membranes during isotacophoresis in Tris-HCl/beta-alanine buffer system and that this counterflow could be utilized to detect DNA-binding proteins by the method of immunostaining.
a very strong electroosmosis was produced on the nitrocellose membrane during isotachophoretic separation in a system of Tris-beta-alanin buffers.
a very strong electroosmosis was produced on nitocellulose membranes during countercurrent isotacho-phoresis.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of counterflow in isotachophoresic transfer of DNA-binding proteins is a very convenient and effective way for the detection of DNA-binding proteins, including antibodies to DNA.
a very strong electroosmotically induced counterflow can be used to detect DNA-binding proteins on nitrocelluose membranes.
nitrocelluloses can serve as a new type of solid support in the field of immunochemical analysis.
